translate_en|mods/DarkPresence/common/me: The dark is gone (ends the story)
Percent chance to spawn a Taken on each ambient check during the dark. Default 70.
Seconds between ambient spawn checks. Higher = Taken trickle in more slowly. Combine with Max/Chance to tune how heavy the dark feels. Default 9.
How many still-shielded Taken can be active near you at once before ambient spawning pauses. Default 5.

How far from you the dark must be before it can put a Taken on the ground. Raise it to keep them clear of your base and its walls; lower it to have them arrive right on top of you. They never spawn indoors or anywhere inside a building at any setting. Default 10.
Taken trickle in on their own on dark ground around you during the dark hours. Off = Taken only from manuscript events / debug.

Turns on the mod's log output and the F6 Director panel (spawn/cleanse Taken, jump the clock, force a storm, hand yourself pages and the beacon, preview the credits) plus debug keys K/L/P/B/J. For testing and filming. Default off.
Cleansed Taken dissolve at dawn too

A Taken whose shield you burned off becomes an ordinary zombie, and by default it survives the dawn - so a busy night leaves a crowd to clear every morning. On: they dissolve with the rest, and the day starts clean. Requires 'Taken dissolve at clear dawn'. Default off.
When a clear day returns (not night/rain/fog/storm), still-shielded Taken dissolve away. Off = they linger as killable zombies. Default on.
Seconds a Taken must spend under full light for its darkness shield to burn off completely. Higher = tougher Taken. Default 10.
Standing in darkness with Taken nearby steadily raises Panic; getting into the light or clear of them calms it. Off = no mood effect.
How the Craft Flood Light recipe is unlocked. Blueprint = find a schematic in the world. Skill = reach Electricity level 3. Always = known from day 1.

On: rain, fog and heavy overcast count as the dark's time, so Taken roam during storms and gloomy days as well as at night - the dark needs the absence of light, not the clock. Off: a strictly nocturnal threat. Clear nights only, and a foggy afternoon stays an ordinary foggy afternoon. Default on.
As the manuscript is read, the days darken and shorten. Requires Story mode. Default on.
Dark storms roll in on their own

Once a day the dark may bring its own storm in the evening, not just when a manuscript page summons one. It never stacks: skipped if a storm is already running or the weather is already rainy/foggy/overcast. Off = storms only come from the story.
The hour (24h) when Taken begin to spawn and roam on a clear night. Default 23 (11pm). Lower = the threat starts earlier in the evening. Storms/gloom still summon the dark any time.
What Knox County becomes once you win the finale (hold the beacon). The dark can leave for good, loosen its grip but stay, or carry on unchanged.
Upper cap on how many Taken a manuscript page's curse can summon (the punishment escalates the deeper you read). Lower = gentler late game.
Chance the dark frequency (90.2) actually transmits during each eligible dead hour (00:00-03:00). Lower = rarer, more haunting. 0 = the radio never airs.

A hidden station at 90.2 that airs in the dead hours (00:00-03:00). With Story mode on it dictates manuscript pages; with Story mode off it still broadcasts survivor chatter as atmosphere. Default on.
Seconds in darkness to rebuild a full shield from nothing. Compare with Shield drain time: higher = light damage sticks for longer. Default 25.
I don't know what this does.

A Taken you burned but did not finish rebuilds its darkness shield once it is back in real darkness. Cleansing is still permanent -- a shield burned all the way off never comes back. Off = any damage you do to a shield is permanent.

A faint white ring over a shielded Taken that tightens as your light burns its darkness away, so you can see how much shield is left. It shows while light is actually burning one and fades a few seconds after, so the night is not full of circles. Off = no rings; judge it by eye.
Percent chance per day that a dark storm rolls in on its own. Default 15.
During a Dark Presence storm, nearby powered lights stutter and cut for a moment. Purely atmospheric. Off = steady lights.

Off = a combat-only sandbox: no manuscript pages, no Leak, no beacon finale. Just the Taken and the light-as-weapon fight. The dark frequency keeps broadcasting survivor chatter as atmosphere, but it will never hand out a page. (Off also forces the Leak option off.)

Lingering outdoors near Taken slowly builds 'taint'; at thresholds the dark leaves eerie notes, and at max it draws a Taken to you. Rare by design (~10+ min of lingering). Off = no taint notes or spawns.
How fast the dark notices you (%)

Speed of the taint that builds while you linger outdoors near Taken, and drains in shelter. 100 = default (~11 real minutes of lingering to be fully noticed). Raise it to be hunted sooner and far more often - 400 makes the dark find you most nights. Lower it for a rarer, slower dread. Requires 'The dark notices you'.

While it's Taken time (night / gloom), the darkness can possess ordinary zombies shambling outdoors in the dark near you, turning them into Taken. Shares the ambient Taken cap. Off = Taken only appear via spawning.

Spawn distinct Taken types that differ by SPEED only: sprinting Lurkers (icy rim) and shambling Anchors (violet rim) alongside normal Taken. Every variant takes the same light to burn, so only the pace of the thing coming for you changes. Off = all Taken are identical.
Chance, per check, that the dark possesses a nearby ordinary zombie and turns it into a Taken (when 'The dark claims walkers' is on). Higher = more turn.
